create_image_text_webdataset: create an ImageTextWebDataset from TAR file shards with a custom mapper and buffer shuffling
build_redcaps_tar_mapper: build a RedCapsTarMapper to preprocess image-text instances with optional subreddit name prefixing
iterate_webdataset_shards: iterate over TAR file shards using ImageTextWebDataset with infinite stream or single epoch mode
transform_images_with_mapper: transform images using RedCapsTarMapper with torchvision transforms and word-segmented subreddit captions
configure_distributed_tar_loading: configure ImageTextWebDataset to shard TAR files across GPU processes for distributed training
